title: Being Charitable is the Best Protection
body:
On the way to Allah you must learn to be charitable. Try to be the one with the upper hand, who gives, not the
one who takes. Give for His sake. Whatever you give in charity will not lessen your wealth, it will increase. It
will protect you from accidents, your family and property will be protected from seen and unseen harm. Put
up a charity box at the door and every time you come or go put something in there.
- 01.01.1996
